periods.name: 蕾姬与璃璃色金观察同学会
periods.summary: Kinji and Aria visit Reki's hotel room overlooking the port. Reki says the wind/Ruriirokane told her the reunion is a gathering that should not be held.
periods.outcome: Sherlock later excludes Reki from the field team as an intelligence-leak risk.
